'''Pavan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
